description: Employment field rules per income type, agreed 2026-10-07; out-of-policy block added 2026-10-15 (written by AI). Based on train_raw.parquet.

out_of_policy.message: Applicant falls outside lending policy. Not scored by this model.

income_types.Pensioner: Policy decision 2026-10-15. Scoring them relies on Missing bins dominated by pensioners themselves.
income_types.Unemployed: Policy decision 2026-10-15. 16 training rows (31% default), too few to score.
income_types.Businessman: Policy decision 2026-10-15. Treated as too risky to lend to; 6 training rows (0 defaults) sit in the pensioner-dominated income bin.
income_types.Maternity leave: Policy decision 2026-10-15. 3 training rows (0 defaults) sit in the pensioner-dominated income bin.

not_offered.Student: 15 training rows, all with employment years; outside this model's scope

age_checks.rule: employment_years <= age - 14 is a hard error; implied start age under 16 is a warning
